title: add: VPC control plane Terraform - multi-AZ peering, Route53, SGs, interface endpoints
author: Ava Martinez
description: Context: Add Terraform modules and examples to provision VPC control plane networking for Private deployments across multiple AZs. Motivation: customers deploying Redwood Private require documented, repeatable infrastructure to provision subnets, interface endpoints, security groups, cross-account VPC peering, and Route53 private hosted zone peering so control plane components can be placed in customer VPCs with minimal manual steps. Design: - New module aws/vpc-control-plane with submodules for subnets (private isolated subnets per AZ), interface endpoints (S3, ECR, KMS), peering (cross-account route propagation and route table automation), security groups with least-privilege rules, and route53-zone-association/peering support. - Multi-AZ deployment defaults to 3 AZs with configurable AZ count, CIDR sizing, and tags. - Outputs include peering connection IDs, endpoint IDs, route table IDs, and hosted zone IDs to be consumed by the installer. - Added comprehensive documentation and example root module for multi-account setups. Changes: - Terraform files: modules/aws/vpc-control-plane/{main.tf,variables.tf,outputs.tf,peering.tf,endpoints.tf,sg.tf,route53.tf} - Examples: examples/multi-az-control-plane/ with root module wiring. - Helm chart values schema updates to align with new outputs. - Installer wiring: redwood-private-installer/terraform/instances uses new module and consumes outputs. - Tests: terratest go/integration tests for peering creation and route propagation. Migration/rollout: This is additive and non-breaking; existing customers continue to use previous modules. Rollout plan: 1) merge module in alpha, 2) enable in internal staging accounts, 3) validate installer integration and run terratest suite, 4) ship as beta in next private-installer release. Checklist: - [x] Terraform module and examples - [x] Unit docs and examples - [x] Terratest integration tests - [x] Console/installer wiring - [x] CI passing - [x] Reviewed for IAM least-privilege. Notes: added guidance on cross-account peering quotas and retries for eventual consistency with route table propagation.
